Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّيْ فِيْهِ عَلَى صِيَامِهِ وَقِيَامِهِ
Translation: O Allah, help me in this month with its fasting and its night prayers

Arabic text: وَجَنِّبْنِيْ فِيْهِ مِنْ هَفَوَاتِهِ وَ آثَامِهِ
Translation: And protect me in it from its errors and sins
And grant me in it the ability to remember You continuously
By Your guidance, O Guide of those who have gone astray
